Messages.Author: Smiling Tom
Messages.Body:
So, a few more questions upon this tricky card: Legion

First idea of a combo: Agaitas and Legion. This I'm quite sure might work.
If a have a legion on one of my vamps, and agaitas ready, and I hace been
replacing cards I've played with cards from my prey's library, using agaitas
special. If any moment I create a new vamp via legion, all the cards I'll
draw to replace my hand will come from my own library, is it ok?

Then the Nedal case. Nedal card text says no combat card played by nedal
are not replaced until my next untap phase. If I manage to enter combat with
him, play several combat cards, and so. If I create a new vamp using legion
(say, a Lambach Merged with 3 legion actions on) do I discard and replace my
full hand or just my full hand minus the combat cards I've just played with
Nedal?

If it's the second case, then a really curious weenie CEL deck might see the
light...

Smiling Tom

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Smiling Tom wrote:
> So, a few more questions upon this tricky card: Legion
>
> First idea of a combo: Agaitas and Legion. This I'm quite sure might work.
> If a have a legion on one of my vamps, and agaitas ready, and I hace been
> replacing cards I've played with cards from my prey's library, using agaitas
> special. If any moment I create a new vamp via legion, all the cards I'll
> draw to replace my hand will come from my own library, is it ok?

Yes.

> Then the Nedal case. Nedal card text says no combat card played by nedal
> are not replaced until my next untap phase. If I manage to enter combat with
> him, play several combat cards, and so. If I create a new vamp using legion
> (say, a Lambach Merged with 3 legion actions on) do I discard and replace my
> full hand or just my full hand minus the combat cards I've just played with
> Nedal?

The latter.
Cards you are currently not replacing count against your hand size.

> If it's the second case, then a really curious weenie CEL deck might see the
> light...

Light it up.

mmm.. considering the first combos with Legion : just play giovanni.
You can do recursion with pochtli and other necromancy cards so discarding
your hand is not a so big disadvantage. You can slap dominate master cards
on your fledglings for maximum bleed and deflection effect. You can play
with nedal (nec cel, exactly like pochtli), which will bum's rush a bugging
vampire, play concealed weapon, Saturday night special, flash, dragon breath
rounds. That makes at least 5 cards you will not replace until your next
turn : so at least 5 cards you won't have to discard when you take the
Legion action. Other fledglings can do the same cheesy, recyclable combo.
And of course you can send them diablerize. they're expendable. This can
work like a charm... or just rot in hell.

comments anyone ? =)
